provenance.hash_scope: Example and executable digests collected directly after successful measured execution; exact baseline binary unavailable, both modes run same executable. Current engine dirty-tree source manifests recorded in companion artifact, not independently reconstructed build provenance.

configuration.mutations: Round%4==0 deletes ID round%64, others upsert deterministic replacement vector; independent mirrored database updated after each completed round.
configuration.storage: Mixed writes use disk-backed Database and ordinary per-write sync; COW pairs use in-memory database to exclude disk sync.
configuration.schedule: Reader computes mirrored-state reference outside timer, acquires owner read lock, captures generation if snapshot mode, then signals waiting writer. Lock-held mode retains guard throughout scan; snapshot mode drops guard before signal. Main reader waits for write completion before next round. This deliberately creates contention, not arbitrary arrivals.

correctness: Every scan result IDs and f64 distance bits equal independently mirrored pre-write state.
After every durable write, current result bits and physical row count equal mirrored post-write state.
Read and write rounds include deletes/upserts. Snapshot scan observes old state even when writer completes before scan returns.
Warm COW pairs verify record count and replacement vector, with reference capture kept alive through timed first write.

timing_columns.cow: First write after optional capture,21 alternating pairs following untimed unique+shared warmup; drop old generation outside write timing.

limits: Native Windows shared development host, warm4MiB vector working set, one reader and writer, single Rayon thread; scheduling/CPU/storage noise remain.
Controlled reader-first schedule favors exposing lock interference; not representative production arrival rate, throughput, or tail-latency guarantee.

Reference scan precedes measured scan and warms caches. Modes alternate order by trial but individual samples are not independent. p95 uses nearest-rank across only72 samples; no confidence intervals.
Snapshot total includes final snapshot release, which may free old ID tree/record bodies after concurrent COW; scan duration excludes that release.
Snapshot writer lock wait can shrink while its mutation work grows due O(n) ID-tree copy and Arc refcount traffic. Read total may worsen due concurrent memory traffic and generation reclamation.
No isolated historical pre-Arc scan benchmark or RSS/allocator measurement; companion artifact explicitly documents per-record allocation/pointer-locality cost.
No fixed general speedup claim; first-write COW costs apply when old generations are retained, logical retention caps are not RSS limits.
